ache.title: An Eidolon tierlist ‘for F2P’. Hmm, Nero
ache.note: He says it himself: Eidolons can cost as much as new characters. Then he ranks E1 and E2 from ‘Saucy’ to ‘Don’t,’ and promises lists for E4 and E6 next. Aimed at free-to-play and low spenders, a list like this makes buying dupes feel like smart planning. That ‘Saucy’ label is doing a lot of selling.
watch: E4 and E6 lists promised next
ache.tip: Treat every Eidolon as ‘Don’t’ by default. One copy is a whole character, and that’s enough.
lines: E1, E2, E4, E6... the list never ends

textData.text: In this video, I dive into the highly anticipated Eidolon tier list, especially curated for free to play and low spender players. Since Eidolons can cost as much as new characters, it's vital to know which ones are worth the investment. This tier list focuses on Eidolon levels 1 and 2, ranking them from 'Saucy' (gameplay changing) to 'Don't' (not meta-relevant). Starting with Acheron and moving alphabetically, I provide detailed analysis and calculations to help you make informed decisions. Plus, stay tuned for future tier lists covering Eidolon levels 4 and 6!
